desc: Precompute the degree of each vertex and identify leaf vertices (degree 1).
For each vertex $v$, compute $LeafCount(v)$, the number of its neighbors that are leaves.
Iterate over each vertex $C$ from 1 to $N$ as the potential center.
For each center $C$, iterate over its neighbors $v$ to compute $L(v) = LeafCount(v) - (1 \text{ if } deg(C)==1 \text{ else } 0)$.
Collect all $L(v)$ values for the neighbors of $C$, sort them in descending order.
For each index $i$ in the sorted list, calculate the kept vertices as $1 + (i+1) \cdot (1 + L_i)$ (using 0-based index for list, so count is $i+1$). Update the global maximum kept vertices.
The answer is $N$ minus the global maximum kept vertices.
